questions.label: 2026학년도 수능 · 19번
questions.prompt: 19. 다음 글에 드러난 Sophie의 심경 변화로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage: “Where could it be?” Sophie asked herself. It had been more than ten years since she had last visited the area where she had grown up. The village had changed a lot over time. Uncertain, she awkwardly looked around at her surroundings. She walked the narrow streets of the village, unsure about which way to go. Suddenly, Sophie saw a familiar sight. “Yes, this must be it,” she thought. In front of her was a wall with flowers painted on it. Although the colors were now faded, the familiar shapes on the wall were the same ones she had painted with her father as a child. Sophie nodded, smiled brightly, and walked toward the gate. At last, she had finally found the house she had grown up in.

confident → embarrassed
thrilled → anxious
relieved → nervous
bored → excited

review.summary: 정답 ①. Sophie는 처음에는 길을 몰라 혼란스럽고, 뒤에서는 집을 찾아 기뻐합니다.
review.approach: 목적·심경은 첫 문장부터 상황을 잡고, 마지막 행동이나 감정 변화가 선지와 맞는지 확인합니다.
review.reason: 앞부분의 Uncertain, unsure가 혼란을 만들고, 뒤에서는 familiar sight를 확인한 뒤 smile brightly로 감정이 바뀝니다. 그래서 confused에서 pleased로 가는 ①이 가장 정확합니다.
review.decisionCue: 초반 감정 단서와 마지막 표정·행동을 각각 선지의 앞 감정과 뒤 감정에 대응합니다.
review.transferRule: 심경 변화 문제는 시작과 끝이 모두 맞는 선지만 남기고, 한쪽만 맞는 선지는 버립니다.

choiceFeedback.1: ①은 정답입니다. Uncertain과 unsure가 confused를, smiled brightly가 pleased를 직접 보여 줍니다.
choiceFeedback.2: ②는 시작부터 어긋납니다. Sophie는 길을 확신한 confident 상태가 아니라 방향을 몰라 unsure한 상태입니다. 끝부분에도 embarrassed를 뒷받침하는 행동이 없습니다.
choiceFeedback.3: ③의 thrilled는 초반의 Uncertain과 반대이고, anxious도 마지막의 smiled brightly와 반대입니다.
choiceFeedback.4: ④는 감정의 방향을 뒤집었습니다. 처음에는 안도한 것이 아니라 혼란스러웠고, 집을 찾은 뒤에는 nervous가 아니라 밝게 웃습니다.

The study of literature has repeatedly failed to recognize the influence of modern musical lyricists and their contributions to the evolution of language. Unlike Shakespeare, who has been studied and celebrated for his development of the English language, particularly in vocabulary and grammatical structure, modern songwriters have experienced restraints on the acknowledgement of their contributions and largely been ignored. Over the past century, we have witnessed an explosion of incredible literary works by these artists, who, through their music, have used linguistic manipulation and storytelling to enrich our language and literature. Producing lyrics of distinct and complex imagery, songwriters have had an incredible literary impact on our language. Their remarkable works, including influences on modern language development, must be recognized in the field of modern literature.

** restraint: 제약

questions.label: 2026학년도 수능 · 21번
questions.prompt: 21. 밑줄 친 made a lot of work less sticky가 다음 글에서 의미하는
questions.passage:
바로 가장 적절한 것은? Digital platforms have made a lot of work less sticky. As work becomes ever more modularised, commoditised and standardised, and as markets for digital work are created, ties between service work and particular places can be disconnected. While the business process of outsourcing that emerged in the 1990s allowed large companies to take advantage of a ‘global reserve army’ by moving their call centres to cheap and distant labour markets, cloudwork changes the volume and granularity at which geographically non-proximate work can take place. A small business in New York can hire a freelance transcriber in Nairobi one day and New Delhi the next. No offices or factories need to be built, no local regulations are observed, and ― in most cases ― no local taxes are paid. The switch in the production network of work happens by simply sending some emails or clicking some buttons on a digital work platform. And, in this way, the employer leaves behind no material traces in the places where it was once an employer.
* commoditise: 상품화하다
** granularity: 과립상(顆粒狀)

choices.text: settled the locational dilemma of the global markets
elevated the spatial flexibility in conducting business
weakened the geographical expansion of local business
relieved the strict legal processes of regional outsourcing
allowed business to be less complicated in its hiring process

review.summary: 정답 ②. less sticky는 일이 특정 장소에 붙어 있지 않고 공간적으로 유연해졌다는 뜻입니다.
review.approach: 빈칸·밑줄은 빈칸 주변의 앞뒤 논리를 먼저 보고, 마지막에 선지가 그 논리를 일반화하는지 확인합니다.
review.reason: sticky는 특정 장소에 붙어 있다는 느낌입니다. 본문은 디지털 플랫폼 때문에 장소와 일이 분리되고, 고용 위치를 쉽게 바꿀 수 있다고 설명하므로 공간적 유연성을 높였다는 ②가 맞습니다.
review.decisionCue: sticky를 문자 그대로 '장소에 붙어 있음'으로 바꾼 뒤, disconnected와 서로 다른 도시의 고용 예시를 확인합니다.
review.transferRule: 비유 표현은 주변의 정의 문장과 구체적 예시가 공통으로 가리키는 뜻으로 바꿉니다.

choiceFeedback.1: ①의 global markets와 dilemma 해결은 범위가 지나치게 큽니다. 본문은 서비스 노동과 특정 장소의 연결이 약해졌다고만 설명합니다.
choiceFeedback.2: ②는 정답입니다. 한 사업체가 서로 다른 도시의 인력을 선택할 수 있으므로 일을 수행하는 장소의 유연성이 높아졌다는 뜻입니다.
choiceFeedback.3: ③은 방향이 반대입니다. 디지털 플랫폼은 지역 사업의 지리적 확장을 약화한 것이 아니라 더 먼 곳의 노동과 연결합니다.
choiceFeedback.4: ④의 엄격한 법적 절차는 본문에 없습니다. outsourcing의 법률 절차가 간소화되었다는 근거도 없습니다.

questions.label: 2026학년도 수능 · 22번
questions.prompt: 22. 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
A sport ecosystem exists based on the type and rate of coopetition existing. Coopetition is defined as “the simultaneous pursuit of cooperation and competition among firms to leverage strategically important resources for superior value creation purposes”. It is a useful way to understand the dynamic nature of sport businesses which need to collaborate for resource efficiency purposes but potentially compete with each other. This special relationship should be managed properly due to trust and confidence issues being paramount. It can be challenging to be collaborative and competitive in sport as they involve different forms of behaviour. This means a careful balancing act may be required in terms of the amount of emphasis placed on each activity. Often sport managers will try to be more competitive due to performance reasons and less collaborative. By necessity they may need to share information but do so in a cautious manner. This means it might be better to have plans in place about how to pursue both simultaneously. This will ensure one is not neglected at the expense of the other.
* simultaneous: 동시의
** paramount: 최고의

choices.text: 스포츠 산업에서는 협력과 경쟁 사이의 균형 잡힌 접근이 요구된다.
협력에 기반한 경쟁을 위해서 스포츠 정신 함양 교육이 필수적이다.
스포츠에서는 성과를 중요시하기 때문에 협력을 과소평가하기 쉽다.
스포츠 산업에서는 효율적 자원 활용을 위한 전략이 필요하다.
스포츠 산업에서의 성취는 경쟁을 필연적으로 수반한다.

questions.label: 2026학년도 수능 · 23번
questions.prompt: 23. 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
Emphasizing speed over frequency can make sense in contexts where everyone is expected to plan around the timetable, including peak-only commute services and very long trips with low demand. In all other contexts, though, it seems to be a common motorist’s error. Roads are there all the time, so their speed is the most important fact that distinguishes them. But transit is only there if it’s coming soon. If you have a car, you can use a road whenever you want and experience its speed. But transit has to exist when you need it (span), and it needs to be coming soon (frequency). Otherwise, waiting time will wipe out any time savings from a faster service. Unless you’re comfortable planning your life around a particular scheduled trip, speed is worthless without frequency, so a transit map that screams about speed and whispers about frequency may simply be planting confusion.
* commute: 통근
